name: openbb_economy_available_indicators
description:
Catalogue of economic indicator codes and countries a provider offers, through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.available_indicators).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query (keyword, imf only); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (econdb, imf; default econdb).
Fetch a series with openbb_economic_indicators using a code from this list. Keys: econdb, imf need none.
Example: {"provider": "imf", "query": "inflation"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
